mapper.select: SELECT d.tid AS datasource_id, d.db_name AS datasource_name, d.jdbc_url, d.username, d.password, d.driver_class_name, t.tid AS table_id, t.table_name FROM db_datasource_t d JOIN db_table_t t ON t.datasource_id = d.tid AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.is_del = 0 WHERE d.tid = #{datasourceId} AND t.tid = #{tableId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.is_del = 0
